title: Make the active menu item visually stand out more

latest.text: In a meeting on accessibility and Navigation with Mike Herchel, Ralf Koller & Kat Shaw we discussed this issue and decided that this was a best practice that we should implement, but not currently breaking a WCAG 2.2 AA SC. We do hope that
